# awscc_cloudwatch_metric_data_query_definition (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::MetricDataQueryDefinition. A saved CloudWatch metric data query (PromQL, SQL, or Metric Math) with a path that is unique in the account and Region.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expression` (String) The metric query. It is stored as-is and is not validated.
- `path` (String) The name of the metric data query definition. Use '/' to organize definitions into folders. Must be unique in the account and Region. Changing it renames the definition in place.
- `type` (String) The query language of Expression.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to the metric data query definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the metric data query definition.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the metric data query definition was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `metric_data_query_definition_id` (String) The ID of the metric data query definition, generated by the service.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the metric data query definition was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_metric_data_query_definition.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the metric data query definition

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_metric_data_query_definition.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cloudwatch_metric_data_query_definition.example "arn"
```
